name: lm-eval likelihood and multiple-choice metrics
description: A bounded source-only profile of registered likelihood and multiple-choice metrics. It establishes neither a selected task/backend nor a measured result, universal backend support, configured deployment gate or dataset entitlement. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.
